name: Crypto Buddy
tagline: A sourced due-diligence brief on any coin, separating real news from noise
description: Curious about a coin? Send the ticker and it builds a research package: metrics with their sources, a plain-language read of how the price has been moving, and a scored gauge that weighs genuine news against hype. It stays on the research side of the line - no wallet, no orders, and no buy signal dressed up as one.
author: JRNavarro75
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
